sections.thesis: Treasury yields fell on Monday, with the 10-year yield dropping 0.03 percentage point to 5.122%.

sections.thesis: The dollar index held at a 19-month peak on bets for an imminent Fed rate rise, lifted by last week's US inflation figures and hawkish Fed comments.
